verdict.rationale: The only event-triggered behavior in the evidence is pre-request scripts that run automatically before a request is sent (gh-5), with AI help to write them (docs-35). Separately, the CLI can be invoked by external automated systems for tests and monitoring (docs-21), so triggering depends on outside tooling. missing for 10: a user-defined rules or automation engine, triggers on events other than request send (webhooks, schedules, collection changes), configurable actions beyond scripts, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
